  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Exchanges merchant credentials (API key, client ID, and client secret) for a
short-lived JWT access token. The returned token scopes subsequent API calls to
a specific merchant and, optionally, a specific customer. Pass `customerId` when
you want the token to carry customer-level identity — this enables the platform
to validate that API calls correspond to the correct customer context. Tokens issued
for one merchant cannot be used with a different merchant's API key.
